basis: latency measured 2026-09-19 (quality still unmeasured): ollama-cloud Nemotron 3-6 s/call; local gemma4:e4b-32k 5-125 s/step; OpenCode Zen free 6-170 s/call and stalls under load. Quality per role comes from tools/benchmark.py.

orchestrator.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. Judgment + strict structured output (the JSON plan). Needs the strongest model you have; speed matters less.

reviewer.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. Reading + reasoning about a diff; low temperature; few steps.

coder.why: Fast (3-6 s/call). Local qwen3.6 is the private alternative but ~6 min per run.

tester.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. Short edit+run loops — favours fast turns.

researcher.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. Web/reading heavy; needs breadth more than code precision.

doc-writer.why: Small, low-stakes edits — the fast local model is enough.

app-ingestor.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. Reads an unfamiliar repo and writes a small manifest.

analyst.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. Web/reading heavy, needs breadth and careful phrasing.

data-analyst.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. Short write-run-read loops with pandas — favours fast turns.

product-manager.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. Structured spec with judgement about scope.

project-manager.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. Plans and status text; consistency over cleverness.

copywriter.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. Fluent short-form writing; the small local model is a fair fallback.

designer.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. HTML/CSS/SVG is code — a coding-tuned model.

editor.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. Read + judge against a checklist; wants the strongest model.

ops-writer.why: Short, low-stakes process docs — the fast local model is enough.

compliance-reviewer.why: Fast (3-6 s/call) and the model you already trust in Movie Clipper. Conservative risk screen; wants the strongest model.
